scripts.build: pnpm run build:desktop && pnpm run stage:extension && pnpm run stage:legal
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @m3u8-bridge/capture-core test && pnpm --filter @m3u8-bridge/protocol test && pnpm --filter @m3u8-bridge/chrome-extension test && pnpm --filter @m3u8-bridge/ui test
scripts.test:python: PYTHONPATH=engine python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v && PYTHONPATH=engine python3 -m py_compile engine/m3u8_bridge/*.py scripts/check_public_tree.py
scripts.verify: pnpm check:public && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:python && pnpm build && pnpm test:rust
